[b]MOSQUEDA IN A NUTSHELL[/b]
[spoiler]
Mosqueda as a nation came into existence many centuries ago when prisoners, hailing from Elseyr, were sent to North Vespuria to try and establish a settlement there. When the prisoners made contact with the native peoples there, who helped them and gave them food and supplies for their settlement. The land was very swampy and marshy, and was infested with crocodiles and mosquitos especially. The land was referred to as Mosquito Land, which turned into Mosqueda Land, and eventually formed into the name Mosqueda. The settlement, named São Canejas, was a very successful port settlement, and allowed for the expansion of the colonies.

The colonies had been up to this point basically governing themselves, so a republic was established to create a sense of order in the settlements. More and more prisoners and settlers came to the colony, and the colonials and natives got along surprisingly well for the time. This, over the centuries, led to the creation of a mixed Creole-Elseyran identity in the area, having both a common language to use between different tribes and ethnic communities and a distinct regional identity that allowed it to cross into the modern day a surviving and thriving nation.

This is essentially a background for the nation, and I come up with more stuff later in my factbooks
[/spoiler]
